correctness.rationale: The rank-three dual-polar intersection array yields four adjacency eigenvalues and eigenmatrix for distance classes A1,A2,A3. The zero-sum powered-distance eigenbranches are F1,F2,F3, with F2(p)=−1+q²(3^p−2^p) crossing once on (0,1). The proof checks F3<0 by concavity, with exceptional q=2 tangent bound, and F1≤F3; this establishes the exact negative-type interval. Schoenberg equivalence, strict Gaussian positivity on distinct Euclidean realizations and centered Gram rank give the positivity and embedding claims. I independently factored the quotient adjacency characteristic polynomial symbolically in q and verified sign separation for q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11; computations do not replace the field-uniform inequalities.
